name: No Hardware Acceleration - Direct Software Emulation (Example)
author: ApkBolt
description: When Virtual Machine Platform is disabled and kernel hypervisor drivers cannot be installed, emulator acceleration fails. This profile configures ApkBolt to use direct software emulation (-accel off) and software GPU rendering.

notes: Software emulation is 5-10x slower than hardware virtualization; enabling Virtual Machine Platform in Windows Features is strongly recommended
